---
title: "Strain engineering paper"
output-file: index.html
---

Research workspace for a strain engineering paper. Initial graphene geometry and
periodic honeycomb vacancy patterns are prepared, and local MACE-MPA-0
relaxations of two-vacancy 4 × 4, 5 × 5, 20 × 20 and 21 × 21 cells are complete.
A formation-energy scan from 2 × 2 through 10 × 10 is also complete, using a
perfect graphene unit cell as the carbon reference. The first results are
the in-plane displacement field and vacancy formation energies. The 4 × 4 and
5 × 5 relaxations have also been repeated with 19 foundation-model
configurations, with per-atom and per-bond strain compared across models.

| Work package | Page |
|---|---|
| Reference structure, method and strain calculations | [Calculations](calculations/calculations.qmd) |
| First figure: structure and strain response | [Figure 1](fig1_strain/notes.qmd) |
| Foundation-model comparison: 19 model configurations, 4 × 4 and 5 × 5 strain | [Model comparison](comp_models/notes.qmd) |
| Fine-tune set: committee-selected graphene structures with strain, curvature and defects | [Fine-tune set](finetune_set/index.qmd) |

All relaxations reached a maximum force below 0.005 eV/Å at fixed cell
vectors. See the figure page for displacement maps and formation energies, and
the calculations page for method, provenance and numerical data. These are exploratory foundation-model
calculations, with reference-method validation still to do.

Keep shared calculation notes on the calculations page and figure-specific analysis
and caption drafts with Figure 1.
